comment: The three documented performance targets (REQ-027). docs/performance.md is the prose authority explaining them; this file is the machine-readable source the perf gate (test/perf/run_perf_gate.gd) loads, and tools/test_performance_targets.py fails if the two ever disagree.

headlessProtocol.comment: How the headless CI gate measures against the targets. CI hardware is NOT the baseline specification; the gate is a regression tripwire, not a baseline verification.
